permutationLabel: Intermediate score band (Alvarado 6, AIR 5): imaging needed
summary: 38-year-old man, 30 h migratory RIF pain with nausea, afebrile, RIF tenderness without guarding, WBC 11.8, CRP 32. Intermediate probability.

inputs.hpi: 30 hours of pain that started centrally and settled in the right iliac fossa. Nausea, no vomiting, appetite reduced but eating. No fever at home. No urinary symptoms.
symptoms: migration of pain to the right iliac fossa

exam.abdomen: Tender in the right iliac fossa with mild percussion tenderness; no guarding. No mass.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Suspected acute appendicitis
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Suspected acute appendicitis, intermediate probability (Alvarado 6, AIR 5). Imaging before the operative decision.

recommended.knownGapNote: Web: Web CDS has no AIR rule.

recommended.note: WSES 2020 names the AIR and the Adult Appendicitis Score as the best-performing adult scores.
recommended.knownGapNote: Web: Neither platform implements the Adult Appendicitis Score. | iOS CI 2026-09-25 (run 36169134350, database mode): aas not recommended; recommended: alvarado, air, ripasa, news2, rcri, asa, mews

values.note: RIF pain 1 + rebound light 1 + PMN 70–84% 1 + WBC 10–14.9 1 + CRP 10–49 1 = 5 (intermediate).

mustInclude.note: WSES 2020: intermediate-risk patients need imaging (US, then CT if needed) before the decision to operate or discharge.

mustExclude.note: Direct-to-theatre without imaging is not supported for an intermediate band.

guideline.name: WSES Jerusalem guidelines — diagnosis and treatment of acute appendicitis (2020 update)
guideline.section: Clinical scores (AIR/AAS over Alvarado), imaging by age/sex/pregnancy, antibiotic-first option, complicated appendicitis (abscess), antibiotic duration
guideline.citation: Di Saverio S, Podda M, De Simone B, et al. Diagnosis and treatment of acute appendicitis: 2020 update of the WSES Jerusalem guidelines. World J Emerg Surg. 2020;15:27.

guideline.name: Alvarado score (MANTRELS)
guideline.section: Items and weights; ≤4 unlikely, 5–6 possible, 7–8 probable, 9–10 very probable
guideline.citation: Alvarado A. A practical score for the early diagnosis of acute appendicitis. Ann Emerg Med. 1986;15:557–64.

guideline.name: Appendicitis Inflammatory Response (AIR) score
guideline.section: Items and weights; 0–4 low, 5–8 intermediate, 9–12 high probability
guideline.citation: Andersson M, Andersson RE. The appendicitis inflammatory response score: a tool for the diagnosis of acute appendicitis that outperforms the Alvarado score. World J Surg. 2008;32:1843–9.

guideline.name: Adult Appendicitis Score (AAS)
guideline.section: Items and weights; <11 low, 11–15 intermediate, ≥16 high probability
guideline.citation: Sammalkorpi HE, Mentula P, Leppäniemi A. A new adult appendicitis score improves diagnostic accuracy of acute appendicitis — a prospective study. BMC Gastroenterol. 2014;14:114.

rationale: Permutation: score band (intermediate). Tests the arithmetic of both scores in the middle band, that the AIR/AAS are recommended (WSES 2020), and that imaging is proposed before the operative decision.
